answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 35818 Country: India Title: Nikah with Ahl Kitaab Question: Who are Ahl-Kitab today? Is it permissible to marry a Christian or a Jew girl who claims to be Ahl-Kitab? Please answer the question with evidences from the holy Quran and Hadith. Answer ID: 35818 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 74/74/M=1433) The Jews and Christians are called Ahl Kitab (the people of the Book), but today it is hard to find true Ahl Kitab; hence one should not marry a Jew or Christian girl. In this lies the safety of one's religion and faith. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
